summary: Iteration 4 - Live Availability. Backend: 18/18 new pytest cases pass (availability shape, past-time exclusion, party-size bounds 400, bad date 400, unknown zone ignored, 8-guest@19:00 blocking window, zone restriction, 6+-seat matching, cancelled not counted, public 409 + message, staff overbook allowed and counted, pinned table kept, full house). Full regression suite: 88 passed, 1 failed (brute-force lockout test - environmental, see minor). Frontend: loading placeholders, slot chips filtered by date/guests/zone, selected time cleared when it becomes unavailable, booking-no-slots message, 409 toast + auto-refresh of slots, full booking -> booking-reference, staff login -> /staff all verified via Playwright. All TEST_ data cleaned up (0 left); tables/settings untouched.

minor.issue: Lockout key is X-Forwarded-For first IP + email. Egress from the test pod alternates between 2 IPs (35.225.230.28 / 34.170.12.145), so failures get split across two counters and 6th attempt returns 401 instead of 429 (test_iteration2_fixes::test_bruteforce_lockout_public_url). Also means an attacker rotating IPs bypasses lockout. Consider an additional per-email counter.

Review example said 17:30-20:00 blocked for an 8-guest booking at 19:00; actual (correct with half-open [t,t+90) intervals) is 18:00-20:00 because 17:30 visit ends exactly at 19:00. Implementation is consistent; only the example was off.

Conservative: all overlapping bookings must get distinct tables even if they don't overlap each other (e.g. bookings at 17:30 and 19:00 both overlap slot 18:00 but could share one table). May under-report availability on busy nights. Also pre-existing over-booked bookings that can't be matched are silently skipped (fine).

issues: Info shows hours 'Tue-Sun 12:00-15:00 & 18:00-23:30' but slot chips include 15:30-17:30 (slot_start/slot_end settings don't reflect the break) - content/config mismatch, pre-existing.

action_items: Optional: harden login lockout with a per-email counter in addition to IP+email
Optional: consider interval-scheduling based table reuse in can_seat to avoid under-reporting availability
Optional: align opening hours text with slot range or support split service periods
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~900 lines (>700) - consider splitting into routers (auth, public, reservations, settings)
Availability check + insert in public_reserve is not atomic - two simultaneous requests for the last table can both succeed (race). Acceptable for MVP; could use a per-date lock/transaction.
slot_availability loads all tables/reservations per call (fine at this scale).
